To get the votes for a specific contestant, you can either list the vote rows or just count them.

**Count votes for a contestant (by contestant number):**
```sql
SELECT
  c.contestant_number,
  c.contestant_name,
  COUNT(*) AS vote_count
FROM VOTES v
JOIN CONTESTANTS c ON c.contestant_number = v.contestant_number
WHERE v.contestant_number = :contestant_number
GROUP BY c.contestant_number, c.contestant_name;
```

**List all vote records for a contestant:**
```sql
SELECT
  v.vote_id,
  v.phone_number,
  v.state,
  v.contestant_number,
  v.created
FROM VOTES v
WHERE v.contestant_number = :contestant_number
ORDER BY v.created DESC;
```

If you tell me whether you want **counts** or the **individual vote rows**, and whether you’re filtering by **contestant number or name**, I can tailor it exactly.
just want the list of votes for Tabatha Gehling

```sql
SELECT
  v.vote_id,
  v.phone_number,
  v.state,
  v.created
FROM VOTES v
JOIN CONTESTANTS c ON c.contestant_number = v.contestant_number
WHERE c.contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'
ORDER BY v.created DESC;
```
make sure to include the states linked to the votes

```sql
SELECT
  v.vote_id,
  v.phone_number,
  v.state,
  acs.area_code,
  v.created
FROM VOTES v
JOIN CONTESTANTS c
  ON c.contestant_number = v.contestant_number
JOIN AREA_CODE_STATE acs
  ON acs.state = v.state
WHERE c.contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'
ORDER BY v.created DESC;
```
also want the phone numbers linked to the votes

The phone number is already stored on each vote (`VOTES.phone_number`), so you can include it directly:

```sql
SELECT
  v.vote_id,
  v.phone_number,
  v.state,
  acs.area_code,
  v.created
FROM VOTES v
JOIN CONTESTANTS c
  ON c.contestant_number = v.contestant_number
JOIN AREA_CODE_STATE acs
  ON acs.state = v.state
WHERE c.contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'
ORDER BY v.created DESC;
```
also want the vote creation dates included

```sql
SELECT
  v.vote_id,
  v.phone_number,
  v.state,
  acs.area_code,
  v.created AS vote_created
FROM VOTES v
JOIN CONTESTANTS c
  ON c.contestant_number = v.contestant_number
JOIN AREA_CODE_STATE acs
  ON acs.state = v.state
WHERE c.contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'
ORDER BY v.created DESC;
```
